title: Tokenized stock peg run
description: One row per run of scripts/stocks/stock-peg.mjs, written even when the run wrote no token rows, so 'no readings' is never confused with 'never ran'. A run whose issuer list could not be read completely writes this row with registry.complete=false and no token rows.

tokens_considered.description: registry records with supply on this chain; on Base the unminted are skipped, they have no pools

supplemented.description: tokens whose pools were completed from GeckoTerminal

supplement_errors.description: GeckoTerminal reads that failed; those rows keep the DexScreener pools

supplement_skipped.description: full lists not topped up from GeckoTerminal because the run was near its deadline; those rows keep the DexScreener pools

shape_changes.description: what changed in a third party's answer format since the last run (evm/core/stocks/shape.mjs), per source; empty when nothing did. Absent from runs before 12.11

onchain.description: the chain's side of the run (scripts/stocks/onchain-pools.mjs); absent when the issuer list could not be read, and from runs before the recorder read the chain

rpc.description: custom: STP_RPC_BASE or STP_RPC_ROBINHOOD was set; the URL is never written

error.description: set when the chain could not be reached at the start of the run; every reading then stands on the aggregators

discovered.description: pools the factories returned that the pool book did not hold

breaker.description: set when the run stopped reading the chain after several failed tokens in a row; the later rows stand on the aggregators

read_errors.description: tokens whose chain read failed; those rows stand on the aggregators

supplement_deferred.description: full DexScreener lists not topped up from GeckoTerminal this run because the run's request budget went to tokens topped up longer ago; their rows carry pools.topped_up_at

aborted.description: set when the run stopped on an error or at its deadline after the registry was read; the rows before it stand

duration_s.description: wall time of the run, from its start to the row being written

budget_s.description: the time the run was given: its deadline minus its start; null when it ran without a deadline

timing.description: where the run spent its time: every outside request by source, timed until its answer arrived. rpc_block reads a block, rpc_call is an eth_call (the pools' multicall)

n_failed.description: other failures: a non-2xx status, a timeout, a network error
